entry.name: ARC_IMU_CG
entry.description: The ISM330DHCX at the centre of gravity (E-20, ADR-0045).

entry.name: ARC_IMU_FRONT
entry.description: The ISM330DHCX at the front axle (E-21, ADR-0045).

enum.name: ARC_ANGLE_STATUS
enum.description: An angle sensor's own error flags (AS5047P DIAAGC and ERRFL registers). 0 is valid; any bit means the angle can't be trusted (ADR-0038).

entry.name: ARC_ANGLE_STATUS_MAGNET_LOW
entry.description: Magnetic field too weak (MAGL).

entry.name: ARC_ANGLE_STATUS_MAGNET_HIGH
entry.description: Magnetic field too strong (MAGH).

entry.name: ARC_ANGLE_STATUS_CORDIC_OVERFLOW
entry.description: The angle calculation overflowed (COF).

entry.name: ARC_ANGLE_STATUS_READ_ERROR
entry.description: The SPI read failed: parity, framing or an invalid command (ERRFL), or no reply.

entry.name: ARC_ANGLE_STATUS_NOT_READY
entry.description: The sensor's offset compensation hasn't finished since power-up (LF clear).

enum.name: ARC_WATCHDOG_STATE
enum.description: Heartbeat watchdog (SYS-04, ADR-0052): whether heartbeats are arriving, and whether the car is armed.

entry.name: ARC_WATCHDOG_OK
entry.description: Heartbeats arriving and armed: the car may drive.

entry.name: ARC_WATCHDOG_NOT_ARMED
entry.description: Heartbeats arriving, not armed: waiting for the operator's re-arm (after power-on, a heartbeat stop or a fault reset).

entry.name: ARC_WATCHDOG_NO_HEARTBEAT
entry.description: No heartbeats: braking on the e-stop ramp, or held stopped (also from power-on until the first heartbeat). Re-arming needs heartbeats first (ADR-0052).

enum.name: ARC_LATCH_STATE
enum.description: The fault latch and its reset (SYS-25, ADR-0039, ADR-0053).

entry.name: ARC_LATCH_LATCHED
entry.description: Stopped: waiting for the e-stop button on the car.

entry.name: ARC_LATCH_ESTOP_HELD
entry.description: The e-stop is held: waiting for the motor-bus cut at T.

entry.name: ARC_LATCH_CHECKING
entry.description: Released after T: the power-on checks are running.

entry.name: ARC_LATCH_RESET
entry.description: Reset: the car may drive once the operator re-arms.

entry.name: ARC_LATCH_RESTART_REQUIRED
entry.description: Only a power cycle and an inspection clear it (ADR-0039 item 5).

enum.name: ARC_LATCH_CAUSE
enum.description: Why the fault latch is set. The detail (which corner, which check) is in ARC_FAULT.

entry.name: ARC_LATCH_CAUSE_ESTOP
entry.description: The e-stop button was pressed.

entry.name: ARC_LATCH_CAUSE_CORNER
entry.description: A corner went silent, braked on its own or faulted (SYS-25).

entry.name: ARC_LATCH_CAUSE_CHECKS_FAILED
entry.description: The power-on checks didn't pass within the window.

entry.name: ARC_LATCH_CAUSE_TOO_MANY_STOPS
entry.description: Too many stops since power-on.

entry.name: ARC_LATCH_CAUSE_OVERCURRENT
entry.description: A motor controller reported over-current.

entry.name: ARC_LATCH_CAUSE_OVERVOLTAGE
entry.description: A motor controller reported over-voltage.

entry.name: ARC_LATCH_CAUSE_ESTOP_WIRING
entry.description: A corner reports the e-stop with the button released (ADR-0035).

entry.name: ARC_LATCH_CAUSE_COMMAND_BUS
entry.description: The command bus failed: no acknowledgements, or bus-off (SYS-25).

entry.name: ARC_LATCH_CAUSE_STEERING
entry.description: The steering failed: no valid reply, a controller fault, bus-off, or an angle that can't be trusted (SYS-25, ADR-0038).

entry.name: ARC_LATCH_CAUSE_STEERING_DISAGREEMENT
entry.description: The steering angles disagree; needs a restart (ADR-0039 item 5).

enum.name: ARC_MOTOR_STATE
enum.description: Why a motor controller is braking on its own (ADR-0035). Any bit set stops all four corners (SYS-25).

entry.name: ARC_MOTOR_STATE_ESTOP
entry.description: The e-stop input is active; braking on the e-stop ramp.

entry.name: ARC_MOTOR_STATE_COMMAND_TIMEOUT
entry.description: No command on the command bus within the timeout; braking on the e-stop ramp.

message.name: ARC_LINK_STATUS
message.description: Link health, 1 Hz each way. Carries the protocol version, which both sides check.
message.field: The <version> of this file the sender was built from.
Received packets missing since start, from MAVLink sequence numbers.
Packets rejected (CRC or unknown message) since start.

message.name: ARC_IMU_SAMPLE
message.field: Acceleration, body frame (x forward, y left, z up).

message.name: ARC_ANGLE_SAMPLE
message.description: One angle-sensor sample: wheel, suspension or steering knuckle.
message.field: The sensor's error flags; 0 is valid.

message.name: ARC_RIDE_HEIGHT_SAMPLE
message.field: Sensor index: 0–3 corners FL, FR, RL, RR; 4 the ground-speed camera's.

message.name: ARC_MOTOR_STATUS
message.description: One motor controller's full status (ADR-0034). Sent by the controller over its UART (ICD-controller-telemetry) with time_ns in its own clock; the sync MCU maps time_ns to its clock and forwards it to the Orin.
message.field: Sample time: the controller's clock on the UART link, sync-MCU time on the sync link.
Why the controller is braking on its own; 0 is neither.

message.name: ARC_STEERING_STATUS
message.description: Steering actuator status from the moteus-c1 (ADR-0019).
message.field: Output torque estimate from q-axis current.
The moteus-c1's mode register: 0 stopped, 1 fault, 10 position, 11 position timeout, 15 brake; the full list is mjbots' reference.

message.name: ARC_CAMERA_TRIGGER
message.description: A camera trigger pulse, for pairing frames with trigger times (ADR-0021).
message.field: Frame sequence number for this camera.

message.name: ARC_POWER_SAMPLE
message.field: Pack current, positive out of the pack.
Cell voltages, cell 1 at the pack negative.

message.name: ARC_SAFETY_STATE
message.description: The safety state, on every change and periodically.
message.field: 1 while the physical e-stop is active.
The fault latch: what the operator has to do next (ADR-0039).
Why it is latched; NONE once reset.

message.name: ARC_FAULT
message.description: A fault or event, when detected (SYS-19).

message.name: ARC_DRIVE_COMMAND
message.description: Drive and steering command. Latest wins; never retransmitted. Clamped by the safety envelope before any CAN command (SYS-22).
message.field: When the command was computed, in sync-MCU time.

message.name: ARC_OPERATOR_HEARTBEAT
message.description: The operator's heartbeat, forwarded by the Orin from the laptop (SYS-04). Never sent straight from the laptop.
message.field: When the Orin forwarded it, in sync-MCU time.
The laptop's heartbeat counter, passed through.

message.name: ARC_ENVELOPE_SET
message.description: Session safety-envelope limits (SYS-22). The sync MCU confirms with ARC_SAFETY_STATE.
message.field: Speed limit; 3 m/s by default for new experiments.

message.name: ARC_REARM
message.description: The operator's re-arm, forwarded by the Orin like the heartbeat. Ends a heartbeat stop once heartbeats are arriving again (ADR-0052); after a fault stop, accepted only after an e-stop cycle and the power-on checks (ADR-0039). The first commands after it are zero.
message.field: When the Orin forwarded it, in sync-MCU time.
The laptop's re-arm counter, passed through.
